greenLoan.subHeading: A low, secured fixed rate loan with no establishment fee, monthly loan service fee or early repayment fee.
bottomPara: at the property secured by their eligible undefined home loan or investment home loan.

paraGraph: solar panels
Low-rate loan to be repaid over 10 years
The flexibility to make additional payments or pay off your loan sooner with no fees or penalties
$0 establishment fee
$0 monthly loan service fees
Borrow from $5,000 to $30,000 to fund the purchase and installation of eligible energy-efficient products
You won’t have access to an offset account, redraw or features like top-ups
Switching and splitting aren’t available for this loan

Total home loan balances (undefined home/investment home loan(s) and undefined Green Loan/undefined Investment Green Loan) must not exceed Loan to Value Ratio (LVR) of 80% (subject to any postcode restrictions)
Solar panels with a system size equal to or greater than 6 kilowatts (kW) (and inverter if applicable)
Battery packs with a system size equal to or greater than 5 kilowatt-hour (kWh)
Solar hot water system with a minimum system size equal to or greater than 250 litres (L)
Heat pump hot water system with a system size equal to or greater than 250L
Electric vehicle charging station(s)
Switching from gas to electric cooking equipment (products must be all-electric and may include induction cooktop, electric element cooktop, electric oven, electric steam oven)
Enabling components to support solar PV and batteries

Smart/connected home products (for example smart thermostats, hot water control, lighting control, smart plugs for appliances and equipment control, home automation systems for the purpose of improving energy efficiency)
Energy-efficient window treatments
Switching from non-LED to LED lighting
Virtual power plants
subPara: You can use a undefined Green Loan to buy and install one or more of the eligible energy-efficient products listed below.
bottomPara: "Solar panels, battery packs and inverters (if applicable) must be purchased from a New Energy Tech approved seller. The installer must be accredited with Solar Accreditation Australia ,

TIP: It’s important to do some research and spend time finding the right solar retailer and/or installer for your project. Be sure to get multiple quotes and compare them before choosing the right one for you .You can also check out approved solar retailers near you
You can find out more about eligible products in the FAQs

areYouEligible.heading: Are you eligible?
paraGraph: Has a total undefined home loan balance of $150,000 or more at the time the undefined Green Loan is funded (not including any redraw balances, loans for bridging purposes, Viridian Line of Credit limits, Equity Unlock for Seniors loan or the new undefined Green Loan)
The eligible undefined home loan is secured by the same property as the undefined Green Loan

The total Loan to Value Ratio (LVR) of the existing and/or new undefined home loan(s) or investment home loan(s) plus undefined Green Loan(s) does not exceed 80% (subject to any postcode restrictions)

The installation address of the eligible small scale renewables matches the address we have listed as security for your undefined Green Loan and undefined home loan or investment home loan (not a commercial property)
subPara: You can apply for the undefined Green Loan (personal borrower/s only) provided your new or existing undefined home/investment home loan(s) meets the conditions below:
bottomPara: For more information, download the undefined Green Loan guide (PDF) .

switchList.text: Contact your Home Lending Specialist, call us on 13 2224 or visit your nearest branch to confirm your eligibility and complete a undefined Green Loan application. Make sure you obtain any relevant approvals for strata titled properties before completing the application.
If you're conditionally pre-approved, source a quote for eligible energy-efficient products from an approved retailer.
Share the quote with undefined and we’ll let you know when your new undefined Green Loan is approved. You can then instruct your retailer and/or installer to proceed.
Once installation is complete, sign the final invoice and send it to undefined.

We’ll pay the invoice directly to the approved installer or into your nominated Direct Debit account for your undefined Green Loan and you’ll be able to see your undefined Green Loan in NetBank and the undefined app.
